cases.sentence: Между тем с фронта ___ должна была напасть на французов, но при этой колонне был Кутузов.
cases.explain: «другая колонна» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Meanwhile another column was to have attacked the French from the front, but Kutúzov accompanied that column. He well knew that nothing but confusion would come of this battle undertaken against his will, and as far as was in his power held the troops back. He did not advance.

cases.sentence: Когда Кутузову доложили, что в тылу французов, где по донесениям казаков прежде никого не было, теперь было два батальона поляков, он покосился назад на Ермолова (он с ним не говорил еще со ___).
cases.explain: «вчерашнего дня» — after the preposition «со», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When Kutúzov was informed that at the French rear—where according to the reports of the Cossacks there had previously been nobody—there were now two battalions of Poles, he gave a sidelong glance at Ermólov who was behind him and to whom he had not spoken since the previous day.

cases.sentence: Всё сраженье состояло только в том, что̀ сделали казаки Opлова-Денисова; ___ лишь напрасно потеряли несколько сот людей.
cases.explain: «остальные войска» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The whole battle consisted in what Orlóv-Denísov’s Cossacks had done: the rest of the army merely lost some hundreds of men uselessly.

cases.explain: «существенное условие» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “That’s how everything is done with us, all topsy-turvy!” said the Russian officers and generals after the Tarútino battle, letting it be understood that some fool there is doing things all wrong but that we ourselves should not have done so, just as people speak today. But people who talk like that either do not know what they are talking about or deliberately deceive themselves. No battle—Tarútino, Borodinó, or Austerlitz—takes place as those who planned it anticipated. That is an essential condition.
